messages:
incident-bot: 🚨 Pager: elevated user-visible regression rate on /v1/chat.generate in prod (us-west). Rolling sample shows 18% quality drop vs baseline, spike started ~10:04 UTC. Automated routing logs indicate increased traffic to `variant-quant-x2`.
oncall-anya: I'm looking. Confirming alert and paging eng-runtime + ml. Anyone oncall for routing policy?
sam-runtime: I saw the alert. I'm on it — pulling routing decision logs now. Initial hunch: policy optimizer pushed cost-score-based override sending 30% more traffic to quantized cheap variant.
maya-sre: @oncall-anya initial mitigation idea: flip routing weight to preferred stable pool, then disable optimizer rule. Can we do a quick fail-open to stable variant?
lisa-product: Customer impact: support queue shows ~12 tickets mentioning hallucinations and truncated answers since ~10:06. High-impact customers on Dedicated might have degraded SLOs.
ken-support: Confirming multiple enterprise customers reported answer quality mismatch. Escalating to customer success for notifications.
devin-ml: Data: quick eval on 200 recent requests vs gold shows BLEU-like quality drop 0.22 -> 0.17 and more off-topic completions. Looks correlated with `variant-quant-x2`'s higher selection rate.
sam-runtime: Routing logs snippet:
```
2026-03-14T10:05:55Z policy-eval optimizer_v2 -> select variant-quant-x2 (cost_score delta -0.18) for route: /v1/chat.generate
2026-03-14T10:06:12Z traffic_split: stable:0.6, optimizer:0.4 -> post-change optimizer->quant-x2 bias
```
oncall-anya: Actioning mitigation: removing the optimizer override and pinning route to `stable-gpt-l9` for affected customers. Applying now.
oncall-anya: Command run:
```
redwoodctl routes set-weight --route /v1/chat.generate --variant stable-gpt-l9 --weight 0.95 --until 2026-03-14T11:00:00Z
redwoodctl policy disable optimizer_v2 --reason "emergency-quality-regression"
```
sam-runtime: Acknowledged. Policy disabled. Confirming traffic steering metrics — now 93% to stable-gpt-l9 within 30s.
maya-sre: Rolling restart of routers to flush any sticky sessions? sam-runtime, do we need that?
sam-runtime: Not required; KV cache sticky keys are variant-scoped, but since we're pinning, should be OK. I'll monitor latency/QPS.
ken-support: Notifying top-affected customers with a short status note. Draft:
"We're investigating a routing policy regression that caused some traffic to be served by a low-cost model variant, resulting in reduced answer quality. We've pinned traffic back to the stable model and disabled the optimizer. We'll follow up with root cause and timelines."
lisa-product: Good. Add: cause likely optimizer weight change, not a model deploy. Keep messaging clear.
devin-ml: Captured eval overlays. Will run a quick A/B on a 500-sample set to validate immediate improvement.
ops-bot: Deployment event: policy optimizer_v2 disabled by oncall-anya at 2026-03-14T10:07:20Z
sam-runtime: Metrics: quality regression rate falling. Regression rate metric back to baseline within ~6 minutes after pinning. Latency stable.
oncall-anya: Pager update: emergency mitigation applied, traffic pinned, optimizer off. Requesting SRE + ML to do RCA and patch.
maya-sre: Assigning postmortem ticket: PM-INC-2026-314, owners: sam-runtime, devin-ml. Timeline to be drafted within 48h.
lisa-product: Customer impact note: ~1200 requests affected, ~15 enterprise sessions with visible regressions, no data leak or availability impact. Recommend outreach to top 5 customers.
devin-ml: Quick A/B shows quality metrics recovering: aggregate score back within 2% of baseline. I'll attach eval artifacts to the ticket.
ken-support: Will coordinate customer comms and CS handoffs. Any ETA for rollback of optimizer config changes to safe state?
sam-runtime: We'll leave optimizer disabled until we patch scoring thresholds. ETA for patch: 24-36h to add safety guards and simulation tests.
oncall-anya: Final: incident mitigated at 2026-03-14T10:12:00Z. Leaving thread open for RCA and customer follow-ups. Thanks all :heart:
incident-bot: Incident annotated: severity=sev2, mitigated=true, duration=00:08:00, ticket=PM-INC-2026-314
